description: Reduced native callback recovery from live workflows: a locally closed function first loses its transitive global helper, then a repaired helper retains an unforced argument promise to a prior kernel. Original scientific data and provider transcripts are omitted.

cells.code:
records <- read.csv('inputs/calibration.csv')
scale <- diff(records$y)[1]/diff(records$x)[1]
scale_signal <- function(x) x*scale
factory <- function(offset) {
  force(offset)
  function(x) offset+scale_signal(x)
}
callback <- factory(records$y[1]-scale*records$x[1])
stopifnot(max(abs(callback(c(2,4))-c(5,9))) < 1e-10)
saveRDS(callback, 'outputs/model.rds')
writeLines('warm-only', 'outputs/report.txt')

from pathlib import Path
report = Path('outputs/report.txt')
assert report.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == 'cold-pending\n'
report.write_text('failure-observed\n', encoding='utf-8')

records <- read.csv('inputs/calibration.csv')
factory <- function(multiplier) {
  force(multiplier)
  offset <- 1
  helper <- function(x) x*multiplier
  function(x) offset+helper(x)
}
callback <- factory(diff(records$y)[1]/diff(records$x)[1])
saveRDS(callback, 'outputs/model.rds')
prediction <- callback(c(2,4))
stopifnot(max(abs(prediction-c(5,9))) < 1e-10)
write(prediction, 'outputs/report.txt', ncolumns=2)

restored <- readRDS('outputs/model.rds')
previous <- scan('outputs/report.txt', quiet=TRUE)
stopifnot(max(abs(previous-c(5,9))) < 1e-10)
recipe <- environment(restored)
stopifnot(!identical(recipe, globalenv()), exists('helper', recipe, inherits=FALSE), exists('multiplier', recipe, inherits=FALSE))
stopifnot(identical(environment(recipe$helper), recipe), identical(recipe$multiplier, 2))
reversed <- restored(c(4,2))
singleton <- restored(2)
empty <- restored(numeric(0))
stopifnot(max(abs(reversed-c(9,5))) < 1e-10, abs(singleton-5) < 1e-10, is.numeric(empty), length(empty) == 0)
base::write(reversed, file='outputs/report.txt', ncolumns=2)
